data.title: Exxon sees higher refining margins adding $4.5B to Q3 earnings
data.description:
ExxonMobil said Friday that higher refining margins during Q3 could boost its downstream profit by ~$4.5B, according to an 8-K filing, on top of the $4.1B it earned from refining in Q2.

Analysts are expecting Exxon's Q3 refining earnings to reach ~$7.8B, according to data compiled by Bloomberg, which would be the company's best quarter on record; the company is scheduled to report its full quarterly results on October 30.

The Gulf Coast 3-2-1 crack spread, a benchmark of U.S. refining profitability, rose 28% Q/Q and touched a record $72.64 on September 22.

Exxon's surging profits will be partly offset by lower oil prices that likely reduced profits by ~$1.3B, according to the filing, which also said the company expects to take a $2.5B hit from "timing effects," or derivative positions linked to cargoes that have been shipped but not yet delivered.

The company also indicated that ​there were no volume-related disruptions during the quarter caused by the Iran war.

data.title: Tokenization and the Retail Investor — Barrons.com
data.description:
To the Editor:

I love it when Big Money says something will be good for "retail" customers ("The Biggest Change to Stock Trading in Decades Is Coming to Wall Street," Cover Story, Oct. 9). Most retail customers, like me, are investors in a company. We buy shares in hopes that the company will grow along with our investment. Whether the transaction takes a nanosecond or five minutes doesn't really matter much. If I want to change brokerage houses, well, that was a pretty quick process even 20 years ago. The tokenization scheme is money chasing money, and you and I will gain nothing.

Robert Morazes On Barrons.com

To the Editor: Kudos to the creator of the illustrations on the cover and page 19. Hopefully they weren't generated by artificial intelligence, along with the story itself. As an equity investor since the 1980s, witnessing and participating in this evolution and revolution might seem Star Wars-like. May the force be with us!

Tom Verdi Providence, R.I.

Still Too Expensive

To the Editor: Real estate may well still be overpriced ("The Case for Investing in Real Estate Now — Even With Rising Interest Rates," Guide to Wealth, Oct. 9). Cap rates (ratios of net operating income to property price) have risen into the ballpark of 6%. In the 1960s, they were consistently above 8%. In the 1970s, they ran above 10%. I like real estate investment trusts for income, and own some. But expecting appreciation anytime soon is anchored in the great bond bull market, which is over.

R. Paul Drake On Barrons.com

Build Domestically

To the Editor: Regarding "Inside the Big-Money Business of Protecting Data Centers" (Oct. 6), we need to build our own data centers domestically. We can't afford to miss the boat on this and allow other countries to dominate. We've already seen the dangers of becoming overly reliant on overseas labor markets. If we mismanage this, the risk could be irreversible.

Scott Yule On Barrons.com

No Quick and Easy Fix

To the Editor: Most developed countries have too much debt ("Across the Atlantic, Bond Crises Are Brewing. Why It Matters for the U.S.," Other Voices, Oct. 8). The U.S. Congress should heed the warning that France is giving the world and take appropriate action. Congress needs to reduce spending and raise taxes. The first step is to eliminate the annual deficit and then determine whether there is enough growth to pay off the debt in a couple of decades. There's no quick and easy fix to the debt and deficit problem, which is why politicians of all stripes continually refuse to address the problem.

Paul O'Neill On Barrons.com

Send letters to: mail@barrons.com. To be considered for publication, correspondence must bear the writer's name, address, and phone number. Letters are subject to editing.

data.title: Copper One Identifies New Copper Zone 600 Metres Northeast of Main Zone at Redonda Copper-Molybdenum Project, British Columbia
data.description:
(TheNewswire)

Vancouver, BC – October 16, 2026 – TheNewswire - Copper One Resources Corp. (“Copper One”) (CSE: CEXY | OTCID: CEXYF | FSE: IW8 | WKN: A42AGR) (the “Company”) is pleased to report the visual identification of a new copper-mineralized zone in step-out drill hole RED-26-04, approximately 600 metres northeast of the main mineralized zone at its 100%-owned Redonda Copper-Molybdenum Project (“Redonda” or the “Property”), located on West Redonda Island, British Columbia.

The discovery was made during the Company's fully funded, 2,400-metre diamond drilling program. Semi-massive chalcopyrite, a copper-bearing sulphide mineral, and magnetite were observed at approximately 171.30 metres downhole in RED-26-04 (Figure 1). These observations are preliminary, and the presence and grade of copper mineralization remain subject to laboratory analytical confirmation.

David Greenway, President and Chief Executive Officer of Copper One, commented: “The identification of a new zone of strong copper mineralization approximately 600 metres northeast of the main zone marks an exciting development for Copper One and highlights the exploration potential emerging at Redonda. Encountering semi-massive chalcopyrite and magnetite in step-out drill hole RED-26-04 is particularly encouraging as we work to better understand the scale and distribution of mineralization across the property. This zone provides another compelling area for our geological team to investigate and reinforces our confidence in the project's broader exploration potential. While laboratory assays are required to confirm copper grades, these early observations underscore why we believe Redonda represents an important opportunity within our growing portfolio of North American copper assets.”

Drill hole RED-26-04 is being drilled at an inclination of -52 degrees and is planned to reach a total depth of approximately 200 metres. The hole is designed to investigate mineralization northeast of the main zone and provide additional geological information to support the Company's ongoing evaluation of the Redonda system.

Figure 1: New Copper-Mineralized Zone Visually Identified: Semi-massive chalcopyrite and magnetite observed at 171.30 metres in drill hole RED-26-04 approximately 600 metres northeast of the main zone. Mineral content and grade can only be confirmed through laboratory analysis.

Drill Hole RED-26-03 Update

The Company also reports that drill hole RED-26-03 has been completed to a total downhole depth of 234.69 metres (Figures 2 and 3). The hole was drilled at an inclination of -75 degrees.

Redonda hosts an underexplored porphyry copper-molybdenum system within British Columbia’s Coast Suture Zone, a geological belt prospective for porphyry copper mineralization. The current drill program is testing priority targets developed through the integration of historical exploration data, airborne geophysics, recent field mapping and geological interpretation (Figure 4 and 5).

Figure 2: RED 26-03 Drilling completed to a total dept of 234.69 metres.

Figure 3: Drill core from RED-26-03 at approximately 127 metres downhole. Fine grained molybdenite filling all the interstitial space in a short breccia zone.

Figure 4: Location of the planned 2026 drill sites at the Redonda Copper-Molybdenum Project, West Redonda Island, British Columbia.

The 2026 exploration strategy is informed by the technical report on the Redonda Property prepared by W.B. Lennan, P.Geo., and filed under the Company’s SEDAR+ profile in March 2026. Mr. Lennan has reviewed the planned drill program and concurs with its objectives, targets, and design.

To execute the program, Copper One has engaged Paradigm Drilling Ltd. (“Paradigm Drilling”), which has deployed a Boyles T-75 hydraulic, track-mounted diamond drill equipped with NQ tooling and capable of testing targets to depths exceeding 600 metres (1,969 feet).

The Redonda Copper-Molybdenum Project comprises nine mineral claims covering approximately 2,746 hectares (6,786 acres) on West Redonda Island in British Columbia’s Vancouver Mining Division. Exploration conducted since the late 1960s has identified multiple copper-molybdenum mineralized zones that remain open along strike and at depth. Historical exploration by Teck Resources Ltd. (formerly Teck Corp.) in 1979 included nine NQ diamond drill holes totaling 1,681 metres (5,515 feet).

The current drill program is evaluating the extent of the known mineralized system and testing priority targets identified through the Company’s integrated geological and geophysical interpretation. In addition, recent field observations have identified an area that may represent a previously unrecognized mineralized zone exposed along a historic logging road east of the main trend. This area will be systematically mapped and sampled and may become an additional drill target, subject to analytical results.

Figure 5: Reduced-to-pole airborne magnetic survey showing historical drill collars and planned 2026 drill sites at the Redonda Project.

Engagement with the Klahoose First Nation

Copper One is committed to working collaboratively with the Klahoose First Nation (“Klahoose”) throughout the 2026 exploration campaign, with an emphasis on local employment, training opportunities and the use of Klahoose-owned and affiliated businesses wherever practicable. As part of this commitment, the Company has engaged a Klahoose member to perform core splitting and will utilize the Klahoose crew boat for marine transportation during the program.

The Company will maintain ongoing communication with Klahoose regarding exploration activities, work schedules and project milestones. Exploration activities will be conducted in accordance with applicable cultural heritage protocols and environmental best practices, with Copper One continuing to identify opportunities to support skills development, capacity building and meaningful economic participation as exploration advances.

About Redonda

The Redonda Copper-Molybdenum Project is a district-scale porphyry copper-molybdenum exploration project located on West Redonda Island in British Columbia's Vancouver Mining Division. The project comprises nine mineral claims covering approximately 2,746 hectares (6,786 acres) and is situated within the highly prospective Coast Suture Zone, a geological belt known for significant porphyry copper and skarn mineralization.

Redonda lies within the Coast Suture Zone between the Wrangellia Terrane and the Coast Plutonic Complex. Early Cretaceous dioritic intrusions of the Coast Plutonic Complex are cut by at least three later intrusive phases: (i) a quartz plug; (ii) a wide, hornblende-rich dike locally brecciated over approximately 600 metres (1,969 feet) of exposed length; and (iii) several smaller feldspar dikes near the southwestern margin of the hornblende body. Copper-molybdenum mineralization is most concentrated along the hornblende dike, particularly within brecciated zones. The geological setting shares certain characteristics with nearby porphyry systems, including the OKover copper-molybdenum deposit, located approximately 34 km (21 miles) to the southeast (north of Powell River), and the Gambier Copper deposit in Howe Sound. Mineralization at nearby projects is not necessarily indicative of mineralization at Redonda.

Qualified Person

The scientific and technical information contained in this news release has been reviewed and approved by Larry Segerstrom, M.Sc. (Geology), CPG, a non-independent consulting geologist to the Company and a Qualified Person as defined by National Instrument 43-101 – Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects.

Market Awareness

Gold Standard Media, LLC

As previously announced, the Company has entered into an Extension Agreement dated October 6, 2026 with Gold Standard Media, LLC (“GSM”). The extension agreement extends the term of the existing agreement, dated June 19, 2026, by an additional six months to June 19, 2027 and increases the maximum aggregate compensation payable by US$500,000 (from US$1,000,000 to US$1,500,000). GSM’s principal is Kenneth Ameduri. Its business address is 723 W. University Avenue, #110-283, Georgetown, Texas 78626, United States, and it may be contacted by email at CEO@goldstandardir.com or by telephone at +1 512-846-1723. GSM is at arm’s length to the Company, and the Company shall not issue options or other securities in consideration for GSM’s services.

About Copper One Resources Corp.

Copper One Resources Corp. is focused on identifying, acquiring, and advancing high-potential copper, copper-silver-gold, and copper-molybdenum projects to help meet the growing global demand for critical metals required for electrification, AI infrastructure and data centers, renewable energy, defence, and the modernization of power systems.

The Company’s flagship asset is the Majuba Hill Copper-Silver-Gold District, located approximately 156 miles (251 kilometres) from Reno, Nevada. Majuba Hill is an exploration-stage porphyry copper project situated in a premier mining jurisdiction with excellent infrastructure, where ongoing exploration is focused on evaluating the scale and continuity of a large copper-silver-gold mineralized system.

Copper One also owns a 100% interest in the Redonda Copper-Molybdenum Project, located northeast of Campbell River in British Columbia’s Vancouver Mining Division. The district-scale project comprises approximately 2,746.46 hectares (6,786 acres) across nine mineral claims and hosts a porphyry-style copper-molybdenum system within the highly prospective Coast Suture Zone, a geological belt known for significant porphyry copper and skarn mineralization. The Company believes Redonda has the potential to become a significant long-term exploration asset as systematic exploration continues to evaluate the scale and continuity of the mineralized system.

In addition, Copper One holds an option to earn up to a 100% interest in the Redhill Property, located south of Ashcroft, British Columbia, adjacent to the Trans-Canada Highway. The 4,736-hectare (11,704-acre) property hosts volcanogenic massive sulphide (VMS) mineralization prospective for copper, zinc, silver and gold, while also demonstrating potential for epithermal gold mineralization.

Copper One also owns a 100% interest in the Sport Project in Utah through its wholly owned subsidiary, Rooinek Mining Corp., expanding the Company’s portfolio of North American copper exploration assets.

Copper One has entered into a purchase and sale agreement to acquire a 100% interest in the Sword & Gossan Mineral Properties, located in west-central Labrador, Newfoundland and Labrador.

Copper One is advancing its portfolio through systematic exploration, modern geological modelling, and disciplined technical evaluation. The Company remains committed to responsible exploration practices, technical transparency, and creating long-term shareholder value through disciplined exploration and the advancement of critical metals projects across North America.

data.title: Cotecna Group Acquires Energon Labs, Strengthening Global Pharmaceutical Testing Capabilities and Expanding its Presence in India
data.description:
GENEVA, Switzerland and HYDERABAD, India, Oct 16, 2026 - (ACN Newswire) - Cotecna, a leading provider of Testing, Inspection and Certification (TIC) services, today announced the acquisition of Energon Labs, a cGMP-compliant, USFDA-inspected, ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 17025:2017 certified analytical testing laboratory based in Hyderabad, India.

The acquisition strengthens Cotecna's global Life Sciences platform and expands its pharmaceutical testing capabilities across the Pharmaceutical, Biopharmaceutical, Medical Device and Packaging sectors. Serving customers across India, the United States, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East, Energon is recognized for its scientific excellence, regulatory expertise and commitment to quality.

Strategically located in Hyderabad, one of the world's leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology hubs, Energon provides Cotecna with access to highly specialized scientific talent, advanced laboratory infrastructure and a well-established pharmaceutical ecosystem. India is also one of the world's fastest-growing pharmaceutical markets and a critical manufacturing hub for global healthcare supply chains.

The acquisition enhances the Cotecna's ability to support both Indian and international customers with high-quality, regulatory-compliant testing services while delivering greater responsiveness, scalability and operational efficiency across key markets.

The addition of Energon further complements Cotecna's growing pharmaceutical testing network which includes Cotecna Life Sciences, Shiva Analyticals and Neotron Pharma. Together, this capabilities strengthen the Group's ability to support customers throughout the product lifecycle and address evolving global quality, compliance and regulatory requirements.

Energon offers a comprehensive portfolio of analytical testing and quality assurance services, including analytical method development and validation, stability studies, impurity profiling, extractables and leachables, glass delamination studies, peptides and oligonucleotide characterisation, raw material and finished product testing, in-vitro binding studies, packaging compatibility studies, and regulatory support services. These capabilities will further strengthen Cotecna's position as a trusted partner to pharmaceutical manufacturers serving regulated markets worldwide.

Sebastien Dannaud, Chief Executive Officer of Cotecna Group, commented: "We are pleased to welcome Energon Labs to the Cotecna Group. This acquisition represents another important step to support our ambition to become one of the largest providers of Life Sciences testing services in India,and strengthens our position in one of the world's most important pharmaceutical markets."

Amit Chopra, CEO South Asia and Middle East, Cotecna Group, added: "I am delighted to welcome Manikanth Reddy and the talented team of Energon Labs to the Cotecna group. This acquisition aligns perfectly with our strategy of building a comprehensive pharmaceutical testing ecosystem across key growth markets. Energon's strong technical capabilities, experienced team and established customer relationships will enhance our ability to serve pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical and medical device companies across India and globally. Together, we are creating a stronger platform to support the evolving needs of the pharmaceutical and healthcare sectors. "

Manikanth Reddy, Founder, Energon, said: "Joining the Cotecna Group opens an exciting new chapter for Energon Labs. Over the years, we have focused on building a laboratory recognized for quality, scientific expertise and reliability. Becoming part of a global organization like Cotecna provides new opportunities to expand our capabilities, strengthen our service offerings and deliver even greater value to our customers. Our team remains committed to maintaining the highest standards of analytical excellence while supporting the continued growth of the life sciences industry."

About Energon Labs

Energon Labs is a cGMP-compliant, USFDA-inspected, ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 17025:2017 certified analytical testing laboratory located in Hyderabad, India. The company provides comprehensive analytical testing, quality assurance and regulatory support services to pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, medical device and packaging industries, serving customers across India, the United States, Asia Pacific and the Middle East.

About Cotecna

Founded in Switzerland in 1974, Cotecna is a leading provider of Testing, Inspection and Certification services. With operations in more than 55 countries, Cotecna helps clients ensure quality, safety, compliance and sustainability across global supply chains. The Group serves customers across agriculture and food, pharmaceuticals, minerals and metals, consumer products, certification and ESG services through a worldwide network of experts, laboratories and technical specialists.

Source: Cotecna

data.title: Nasdaq 100 Records Worst Week In 18 Months As Investors Steer Clear Of Chipmakers — AAPL, MSTR, UBER, SOXX In Focus
data.description:
Key points:
  • The S&P 500 ended Friday 1.1% lower, the Nasdaq 100 fell 2.5%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average slipped 0.3%.
  • CoreWeave recorded its worst week since November last year.
  • Tesla introduced the Roadster sports car, a prototype designed in collaboration with SpaceX.

U.S. stock indices dropped on Friday, with the Nasdaq 100 recording its worst week in over a year and a half, pulled down by weakness in chip stocks.

The S&P 500 ended Friday 1.1% lower, the Nasdaq 100 fell 2.5%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average slipped 0.3%. The Russell 2000, which tracks small-cap stocks, ended 1.7% lower.

S&P 500 futures slipped 0.2%, while Nasdaq-100 futures dropped 0.7%. Dow Jones Industrial Average futures rose just 22 points.

The SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) dropped 1.2%, and the SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF (DIA) eased 0.5%. Meanwhile, the Nasdaq-100 tracking Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) fell 2.5% on Friday.

Meanwhile, the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) and the iShares Semiconductor ETF fell between 3% and 4% amid weakness in Micron Tech (MU), Nvidia (NVDA), Broadcom (AVGO), and most other silicon makers. The broader Vanguard Information Technology ETF (VGT) dropped 3%.

The Roundhill Memory ETF (DRAM) fell about 6% on Friday, with most memory chip stocks in the red.

Retail sentiment on Stocktwits for QQQ, SPY, and DIA was ‘bearish’ with ‘high’ message volumes.

US Market Drivers

IndexMoveClose
Dow Jones Industrial Average-0.3%52,002.41
S&P 500-1.1%7,659.44
Nasdaq 100-2.5%29,187.55

Anxiety rose among market participants over excessive spending and debt tech firms are taking on to finance AI expansion. Neocloud provider CoreWeave saw its stock tumble almost 12%, extending weekly losses to 25% as its overall debt load ballooned past $51 billion.

Michael Rosen, chief investment officer at Angeles, told CNBC that while mounting debt warrants close monitoring, current levels remain far from systemic danger. “Obviously, increased debt issuance is something to observe and continue to watch and be concerned about if it continues to get to levels of excessiveness. But we’re not remotely close to that right now.”

Alternatively, Nvidia’s chief Jensen Huang has been publicly advocating for the AI industry by saying the benefits of the technology will soon outweigh the concerns of investors.

“All of this is going to pass, and the reason for that is very simple,” Huang told Bloomberg during an event in Berlin. “It’s going to be transformative. It’s going to impact in a very positive way every single industry and every single country. There’s no question it will continue, and we’re at the beginning of that.”

Key Trending Stocks

Apple Inc. (AAPL) is preparing to fight U.K. antitrust regulators over proposed rule changes designed to break the tech giant’s grip on its iPhone tap-to-pay technology.

Shares of Michael Saylor-backed Strategy (MSTR) fell on Friday, reversing Thursday’s gains, after MSCI announced it would adopt a new approach to screening companies for its global benchmark indexes that could put the Bitcoin (BTC) treasury firm’s index membership at risk.

Uber (UBER) shares were in focus after Guggenheim reiterated its ‘Buy’ rating and $125 price target, calling it a “compelling investment opportunity.”

Tesla’s (TSLA) unveiling of its next-generation Roadster on Thursday turned heads as the car drove off a roller-coaster-like ramp, somersaulting over other Tesla vehicles before using cold-gas thrusters to land, but analysts saw it as a precursor to its merger with SpaceX (SPCX).

Shares of ExxonMobil (XOM) advanced modestly on Friday after the company said that higher refining margins could add about $4.5 billion to third-quarter results compared with the prior quarter.

data.title: DGEN TECHNOLOGIES (FORMERLY CHINA KELI ELECTRIC COMPANY) COMPLETES ACQUISITION AND NAME CHANGE AND FILES CSE LISTING STATEMENT
data.description:
VANCOUVER, BC, Oct. 16, 2026 /CNW/ -- DGEN Technologies Corp. (formerly China Keli Electric Company Ltd.) (the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has completed its previously announced acquisition of DGEN Financial Holdings Corp. (formerly DGEN Technologies Corp.) ("DGEN") pursuant to a share exchange agreement dated December 9, 2025, as amended on August 17, 2026 (the "SEA") on October 14, 2026 (the "Transaction").

Pursuant to the Transaction, the Company acquired all of the issued and outstanding shares of DGEN in exchange for the issuance of an aggregate of 9,550,360 common shares of the Company ("Common Shares") and 7,000,360 Common Share purchase warrants ("Warrants") to certain former shareholders of DGEN. Each Warrant entitles the holder to acquire one Common Share at a price of $0.25 until October 14, 2028. As a result of the Transaction, DGEN became a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company. As of the date hereof, the Company has 29,161,364 Common Shares and 7,000,360 Warrants issued and outstanding.

In connection with the completion of the Transaction, the Company changed its name from "China Keli Electric Company Ltd." to "DGEN Technologies Corp." and, hereinafter, will carry on the business of DGEN.

Listing Statement

Following the closing of the Transaction, the Company has filed a CSE Form 2A listing statement dated October 14, 2026 (the "Listing Statement") on SEDAR+ under its profile relating to the Transaction and the proposed CSE listing. Investors are encouraged to review the Listing Statement, which provides detailed information about the Transaction, the Company and its operations.

The Company has received conditional approval to list the Common Shares on the Canadian Securities Exchange (the "CSE") and has delisted the Common Shares from the TSX Venture Exchange in anticipation of listing on the CSE. The Common Shares are expected to commence trading on the CSE under the symbol "DGEN" on or about October 20, 2026.

Board of Directors and Management

data.title: GoPro Restates Some Financials After Discovering Accounting Errors
data.description:
By Elias Schisgall

GoPro is restating some of its financial results after discovering errors in its accounting ahead of its $285 million merger with Starman Optical.

The errors stemmed from the accounting treatment of warrants GoPro issued to Mateo Financing last year, as well as the accounting of some of its debts, the company said in a Friday filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

They were discovered while preparing a proxy statement related to the pending merger. GoPro didn't immediately respond to a request for comment on whether the restatements would impact the merger.

An initial measurement of the company's warrant liability on Aug. 4, 2025, was understated by $8.1 million, while long-term debt was overstated by the same amount, according to the filing.

GoPro said the errors resulted from a material weakness in its internal control over financial reporting, adding that it plans to issue an updated report on its internal controls.

The company restated its first-quarter loss as $76.3 million, or 47 cents a share. That compares with the original report of $80.8 million, or 50 cents a share.

The second-quarter loss, however, was understated by about $200,000, GoPro said. It restated that figure as a net loss of $51.2 million.

GoPro's 2025 results were also impacted by the restatement, with the full-year loss being revised downward to $92.6 million, or 58 cents a share, down from the original report of $93.5 million, or 59 cents a share.

The restatement doesn't cover any of the company's revenue, margin, or operating cash flow results.

data.title: Copper Lake Announces Closing of Second and Final Tranche of Previously Announced Non-Brokered Private Placement
data.description:
Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - October 16, 2026) - Copper Lake Resources Ltd. (FSE: W0I0) ("Copper Lake" or the "Company") announces that it has closed the second and final tranche (the "Final Tranche") of its non-brokered private placement (the "Offering") previously announced on September 3, 2026 (the "Private Placement").

Under the final tranche closing of the Offering, the Company issued 17,708,292 units ("Units") at a price of $0.15 per Unit for gross proceeds of $2,656,243. Each Unit consists of one common share and one Warrant. Each Warrant entitles the holder to acquire one additional share at an exercise price of $0.20 per Common Share for a period of 24 months from the closing date.

The Company has raised a total of $4,999,998 and issued 33,333,323 Units in connection with both tranches of the Offering.

The Warrants shall be subject to an accelerated expiry date clause whereby, at any time following the expiry of the four-months and one day hold period, should the weighted average closing price of the Common Shares on the TSX Venture Exchange (the "TSX-V") be more than $0.40 for a period of 15 consecutive trading days, the Company shall be entitled to accelerate the expiry date of the warrants to a date which is 30 days following the date on which the Company announces the accelerated expiry of the Warrants by press release.

The net proceeds of the financing will be used for exploration at the Company's Marshall Lake project and for general working capital purposes.

In accordance with applicable Canadian securities laws, all securities issued pursuant to the private placement will have a hold period of four months and one day from the date of issuance.

Certain insiders of the Company purchased 1,473,333 Units in the Private Placement and such participation is considered to be a "related party transaction" pursuant to Multilateral Instrument 61-101 ("MI 61-101"). The Company intends to rely on the exemptions from the formal valuation and minority shareholder approval requirements of MI 61-101 contained in Section 5.5(a) and Section 5.7(1)(a) of MI 61-101 in respect of such insider participation.

The Private Placement has been conditionally approved by the TSX Venture Exchange, but completion of the private placement remains subject to the receipt of all necessary regulatory approvals, including approval of the TSX-V.

In accordance with applicable Canadian securities laws, all securities issued pursuant to the private placement will have a hold period of four months and one day from the date of issuance.

ABOUT COPPER LAKE RESOURCES

Copper Lake Resources Ltd. is a publicly traded Canadian mineral exploration and development company with interests in two projects both located in Ontario.

The Marshall Lake high-grade VMS copper, zinc, silver and gold project, comprises an area of approximately 220 square km located 120 km north of Geraldton, Ontario and is just 22 km north of the main CNR rail line. Copper Lake has an 82.97% interest in the joint ventured property, which consists of 233 claims and 52 mining leases. The project also includes 148 claim cells staked in 2018 and 2020 that are 100% owned and not subject to any royalties. These newer claims add approximately 30 square km to the property.

In addition to the original Marshall Lake property above, Marshall Lake also includes the Sollas Lake and Summit Lake properties, which are 100% owned by the Company and are not subject to any royalties. The Sollas Lake property consists of 20 claim cells comprising an area of 4 square km on the east side of the Marshall Lake property where historical EM airborne geophysical surveys have outlined strong conductors on the property hosted within the same favorable felsic volcanic units. The Summit Lake property currently consists of 100 claim cells comprising an area of 20.5 square km, is accessible year-round, and is located immediately west of the original Marshall Lake property. The Marshall Lake project is located in the traditional territories of Aroland and Animbiigoo Zaagi'igan Anishinaabek ("AZA") First Nations.

Copper Lake has a 69.79% joint venture interest in the Norton Lake nickel, copper, cobalt, and palladium PGM property, located in the southern Ring of Fire area, is approximately 100 km north of the Marshall Lake Property. The Company filed an updated NI 43-101 in October 2023 with a mineral resource of open pit and underground Measured + Indicated Resources of 1,795,000 tonnes at an average grade of 0.72% NI, 0.69% Cu, 339 ppm Co, 0.52 g/t Pd, 0.17 g/t Pt and containing 28.3Mlbs of nickel and 27.3Mlbs of copper. The Norton Lake property is located in the traditional territories of Eabametoong ("Fort Hope") and Neskantaga First Nations.

data.title: Air Traffic Controllers' Practice of Leaving Work Early Targeted in Pay Deal — WSJ
Yes Bank flags 250-bps impact on core capital ratio after Supreme Court upholds AT-1 bond write-off ruling
data.description:
New Delhi, Oct. 17 -- Yes Bank said its Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital ratio could decline by around 250 basis points, a day after the Supreme Court upheld the Bombay High Court judgment against the write-down of Additional Tier-1 (AT-1) bonds worth Rs.8,415 crore, undertaken in March 2020 as part of the bank's reconstruction.

The bank's overall Tier 1 capital ratio, however, is expected to remain unchanged at 14% on a pro forma basis, the bank said in its exchange filing on Friday. Capital ratios measure a bank's financial strength by comparing its capital with its risk-weighted assets, indicating its ability to withstand losses.

Additional Tier-1 (AT-1) bonds are perpetual instruments issued by banks to increase their capital base. They are riskier than traditional bonds and typically offer higher interest rates. The RBI can require their write-down or cancellation under specified circumstances if a bank is in financial trouble.

The Supreme Court on Thursday dismissed appeals filed by Yes Bank, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), and the Union government, upholding the Bombay High Court's January 20, 2023, judgment on the matter.

The bank is examining the judgment in detail, including evaluating all available legal options and suitable actions or steps going forward, Yes Bank said in a regulatory filing.

The bank also said it has access to various capital-management levers and retains the flexibility to undertake additional capital actions, as considered appropriate, to pursue its growth objectives.

The bank remains focused on strengthening its franchise and providing consistent service and support to customers across their banking requirements, it added.

Separately, S&P Global Ratings said it does not expect the Supreme Court ruling against Yes Bank to affect its ratings, although it could weigh on future earnings, Reuters reported.

Yes Bank's regulatory capital is adequate, with its Common Equity Tier 1 ratio of 13.87% as of the end of March 2026 able to absorb the expected 250-basis-point hit while remaining well above the minimum requirement of 5.5%, S&P said.

The ratings agency said the lender's credit profile could withstand the ruling, which addresses procedural lapses in the write-down under the 2020 rescue. S&P expects Yes Bank to remain adequately capitalised, with its risk-adjusted capital ratio projected to remain between 8% and 8.5% through March 2028, compared with 9% in March 2026, according to the report.

Following the news, investors grew concerned about the bank's financial health, resulting in a 14% crash in Thursday's trade. The sell-off extended into Friday's session, with the stock falling another 3.42%.

The losses have widened the bank's October losses to 17% so far, while the stock has declined 19% in 2026.

data.title: Tesla Showcases Roadster With SpaceX-Developed Thrusters In Dramatic Aerial Demonstration
data.description:
WASHINGTON (dpa-AFX) - Tesla (TSLA) has showcased its redesigned Roadster performing aerial stunts using rocket-inspired cold-gas thrusters developed with help from SpaceX engineers, offering a new look at the long-delayed electric sports car ahead of its expected 2028 production.

During the October 15 demonstration near Waco, Texas, the two-seat Roadster drove up a curved ramp, briefly remained upside down using a suction system and launched into the air before landing on its wheels. It also performed a jump over several Tesla vehicles.

Tesla showed footage indicating the Roadster accelerating from zero to 60 miles per hour in 0.81 seconds, though the performance has not been independently verified.

The company has not confirmed whether the thrusters and flying capabilities demonstrated by the prototype will appear on the production vehicle.

Final specifications, pricing and delivery details also remain unclear. The next-generation Roadster was originally unveiled in 2017 but has faced repeated production delays.
